issue_type: Missing accessible names or form labels
description: Applicant full name and disability certificate ID input fields lack programmatic labels and accessible descriptions.
evidence: <input id="cert_num" type="text" class="form-ctrl"> lacking for attribute or aria-label
recommended_fix: Associate <label for="cert_num">Disability Certificate ID</label> and add aria-required="true".

description: Custom modal dialog for proof-of-eligibility document upload traps keyboard focus and cannot be dismissed with Escape.
evidence: #upload-dialog traps Tab key and suppresses keyboard events on close icon button
recommended_fix: Implement standard accessible modal dialog pattern with focus trapping within modal and Esc key dismiss.

description: Credit card expiration and CVV validation errors only flash red border without textual error message or aria-live announcement.
evidence: Border style turns red (#E53E3E) on blur with no error container or role="alert"
recommended_fix: Add dedicated error text container with role="alert" linked via aria-describedby to input fields.

description: The primary 'Authorize Payment' submit button completely strips browser outline on :focus without providing an alternative focus ring.
evidence: button.btn-pay:focus { outline: none; box-shadow: none; }
recommended_fix: Provide high-contrast visible focus indicator (minimum 3:1 contrast against surrounding background).

description: Transit route timeline text and intermediate transfer stop names display light gray on white (contrast ratio 2.4:1).
evidence: Color #A0AEC0 on #FFFFFF (WCAG AA requires 4.5:1 for normal text)
recommended_fix: Update secondary route text color to #4A5568 or darker to achieve at least 4.5:1 contrast.

description: Step-by-step route transfer diagrams use informative SVG icons showing wheelchair accessible vehicles with empty alt attributes.
evidence: conveyed without text equivalent
recommended_fix: Provide descriptive alt text e.g. alt="Wheelchair ramp equipped vehicle available on this route".

description: Timetable page skips from <h1> title directly to <h4> for individual bus terminal departures.
evidence:
Heading order:

System Schedule

followed directly by

Terminal 4 Departures
recommended_fix: Restructure headings sequentially using <h2> for service routes and <h3> for terminal stops.

description: Multiple emergency detour notices conclude with ambiguous anchor text 'Click here' instead of descriptive destination.
evidence: Click here
recommended_fix: Replace generic link text with descriptive phrase e.g. "View Line 12 detour schedule".

description: Ordering form fails silently when an invalid date of birth format is entered; user is not notified which field caused failure.
evidence: Submission rejected without setting aria-invalid or focusing the invalid DOB field
recommended_fix: Set aria-invalid="true" on error field, shift focus to summary error container with clear instructions.

issue_type: Missing accessible names or form labels
description: The relationship-to-registrant dropdown select element relies solely on placeholder text which disappears upon selection.
evidence: <select id="rel_code"><option value="">Select relationship...</option></select> lacking label
recommended_fix: Add explicit <label for="rel_code">Relationship to Registrant</label>.

description: Interactive calendar date picker widget cannot be navigated or operated using Arrow keys or Tab key.
evidence: Calendar grid table lacks keyboard handlers and roledescription="calendar"
recommended_fix: Provide full keyboard support per WAI-ARIA grid design pattern or allow direct text entry of appointment date.

description: Date picker navigation buttons ('Previous Month' and 'Next Month') have zero focus indicator when focused via Tab.
evidence: .cal-nav-btn:focus { outline: 0; }
recommended_fix: Add 2px solid #005A9C outline with 2px offset on keyboard focus.

description: Eligibility income qualification thresholds table uses pale green text on light gray background (contrast 2.8:1).
evidence: Style #68D391 on #F7FAFC fails minimum contrast threshold
recommended_fix: Adjust text color to #22543D to ensure minimum 4.5:1 contrast against table background.

description: Scanned PDF income verification guide is embedded as raw canvas graphic without accessible text or transcription.
evidence: <canvas id="income-guide-canvas"> rendering document text without text alternatives
recommended_fix: Provide equivalent accessible HTML table or tagged accessible PDF download with OCR text.

description: Search result cards for 15 health centers all end with identical link text 'Learn More' without context.
evidence: Learn More repeated 15 times on single page
recommended_fix: Use aria-label or accessible link text like "Learn more about Downtown Community Health Center".

description: Inspection lookup page encloses visual section headers inside <div> tags with bold text instead of semantic <h2> tags.
evidence:
Recent Violations
styled to mimic header
recommended_fix: Replace styled div tags with semantic <h2> elements for screen reader document outline navigation.

issue_type: Missing accessible names or form labels
description: Main catalog search query input and faceted filter search inputs lack accessible labels or title attributes.
evidence: <input type="search" id="cat-search" placeholder="Search catalog..."> without label
recommended_fix: Add <label for="cat-search" class="visually-hidden">Search Library Catalog</label>.

description: Facet filter accordion dropdowns for 'Format' and 'Availability' do not open or toggle when pressing Enter or Space.
evidence: Accordion implemented with <div onclick="..."> without role="button" or keydown listeners
recommended_fix: Convert accordions to native <button aria-expanded="..."> elements with standard keyboard event handling.

description: PIN code selection requires 4 numerical digits but displays generic 'Invalid Entry' error without specifying required criteria.
evidence: Generic error text "Invalid Entry" rendered in small 10px gray font
recommended_fix: Display descriptive validation rule "PIN must contain exactly 4 numeric digits" and connect via aria-describedby.

description: Checkboxes for 'Accept Terms of Use' and 'Opt-in for Audio Notifications' suppress focus rectangle.
evidence: input[type="checkbox"]:focus { outline: none; }
recommended_fix: Restore high-visibility focus ring to all form controls.

description: Photographs of adaptive braille embossers and high-contrast keyboards have non-descriptive alt='IMG_4021.JPG'.
recommended_fix: Update alt text to describe device: alt="Braille embosser station available in Room 204".

description: Available time slots are marked with light yellow background and white numerals (contrast ratio 1.7:1).
evidence: Yellow indicator #ECC94B on #FFFFFF lacks required contrast for essential information
recommended_fix: Enhance contrast to minimum 3:1 for graphical UI components and 4.5:1 for slot time text.

description: Event cards for monthly book club sessions render repeated links reading 'Read details'.
evidence: Read details
recommended_fix: Update to "Read details for Science Fiction Book Club meeting".

description: Multi-step application submission silently drops invalid high school GPA entry and advances step without saving data.
evidence: Wizard next button allows submission without validating previous step inputs
recommended_fix: Validate step inputs before transition; prevent step progression and announce validation errors via aria-live.

description: Step navigation bar tabs in application wizard cannot be activated using keyboard Left/Right arrow keys.
evidence: Wizard steps built with non-focusable <span class="step-circle">
recommended_fix: Refactor to ARIA Tablist pattern with role="tablist", role="tab", and roving tabindex.

issue_type: Missing accessible names or form labels
description: Credit card installment plan selection radio button group has no <fieldset> or <legend> grouping label.
evidence: Three radio inputs rendered with detached text spans lacking group context
recommended_fix: Wrap radio controls inside <fieldset><legend>Select Tuition Payment Schedule</legend>.

description: Payment summary receipt numbers and discount codes are rendered in light pastel blue on white (contrast 2.2:1).
evidence: Text #63B3ED on #FFFFFF
recommended_fix: Darken text color to #2B6CB0 to exceed 4.5:1 contrast requirement.

description: Interactive weekly schedule matrix uses drag-and-drop course adding with no keyboard equivalent.
evidence: Draggable <div> elements listen only for ondragstart and mouse events
recommended_fix: Provide an accessible "Add Course" button interface alongside drag-and-drop with keyboard shortcuts.

description: Resource page jumps from <h1> to <h3> bypassing <h2>; sub-services are grouped under arbitrary <h5> tags.
evidence:
Document outline breaks:

Welcome

->

Accommodation Request

->
Documentation Guidelines
recommended_fix: Organize semantic heading structure logically (H1 -> H2 -> H3).

issue_type: Missing accessible names or form labels
description: Two-factor authentication code inputs (6 separate single-digit boxes) have no labels or accessible descriptors.
evidence: 6 <input maxlength="1"> tags without label aria-label or title
recommended_fix: Add aria-label="Digit 1 of 6 verification code" to each respective verification input.

description: Interactive SVG campus accessible route overlay conveys elevator availability purely through colored circles with no text.
evidence: <circle fill="#38A169"> denoting working elevator with no title or aria-label
recommended_fix: Add <title> and <desc> to SVG elements and provide an accessible textual directory of building elevators.

description: License renewal form blocks submission if residential address check fails, but error message is placed at the top of a 5-page form without focus shift.
evidence: Error banner rendered offscreen at top of page while viewport remains at bottom submit button
recommended_fix: Shift programmatic focus to error summary container upon failed submission with role="alert".

issue_type: Missing accessible names or form labels
description: Vision certification checkmark and optometrist license number inputs lack programmatic connection to their labels.
evidence: Optometrist License ID:
recommended_fix: Wrap in <label> or provide for and id relationship.

description: Document verification drag-and-drop upload zone cannot be reached or activated via Tab or Spacebar.
evidence: Upload zone is <div class="drop-zone"> without tabindex or keyboard file selection trigger
recommended_fix: Add standard accessible <input type="file" class="visually-hidden"> triggered by keyboard-accessible button.

description: Location selector cards in appointment scheduler remove outline on focus, leaving keyboard users unable to locate selected branch.
evidence: .branch-card:focus { outline: none; border-color: inherit; }
recommended_fix: Implement high contrast 3px focus ring around branch cards when tabbed into.

description: Available appointment hour badges display white text on light cyan background (contrast ratio 2.6:1).
evidence: Text #FFFFFF on #76E4F7 fails 4.5:1 contrast requirement
recommended_fix: Update badge background to #0987A0 or text to #004455 for sufficient contrast.

description: Citizenship verification guide footer has multiple links labeled 'Click for more information'.
evidence: Click for more information
recommended_fix: Change anchor text to "Review acceptable proof of citizenship documents".

description: Branch office names are formatted using <b> elements instead of semantic <h3> headings under county <h2> headings.
evidence:
Downtown Field Office

directly beneath

Travis County
recommended_fix: Replace bold paragraph elements with semantic <h3> headings to allow quick screen reader navigation.
